meta.title: Commander Chaos Begins... | 4 Player MTG Commander Gameplay Episode 1
meta.episode: 1 of 3 (game continues in later episodes; this log is partial)
meta.extraction_method: YouTube auto-generated captions (ASR, no speaker labels). Speaker attribution and some card names are inferred; each entry carries a confidence flag.

schema.confidence: high = explicit in transcript; medium = inferred from context; low = ASR garbled, best guess
schema.rule_refs: MTG Comprehensive Rules numbers, resolvable against rules/kb/all_rules.json

pregame.event: All players shuffle and draw opening hands; table announces 'free mulligan for all'

pregame.event: Roll-off (d20) to determine turn order: Weston 13, Jared 17, Bolt 12; Jared wins and sets order; Alex plays first, proceeding clockwise
All four players keep opening hands (no mulligans taken)

actions.detail: Land - Forest Island, enters tapped

Jared draws for turn (first turn-cycle draw allowed in multiplayer for all players incl. first player's successors; only the FIRST player would skip in a 2-player game, and nobody skips in multiplayer)
Sacrifice, search library for a basic land, put onto battlefield tapped, shuffle
Enters tapped; taps for one mana of commander's color identity
Enters tapped; bounce-land played as first land
actions.validation_flag: Orzhov Basilica reads 'When this land enters, return an untapped land you control to its owner's hand.' Played as the only land, the trigger resolves with no legal object to return - legal but worth flagging; discussed at 29:41

actions.detail: Enters tapped unless you control two basic lands (Alex does not - enters tapped)
Holds one mana up, passes
Land drop presumed; transcript is table-talk
Table walks Bolt through untap + draw sequencing
Enters tapped
Paid with 2 mana from Orzhov Basilica; taps for one mana of commander color identity (W/B)
Enters untapped (controls a Forest [Tangled Islet] and a Plains [Prairie Stream])

actions.card: Shelinda, Yevon Acolyte (heard as 'Shelinda Yavon Acolyte')
actions.detail: Tapped W + G. Lifelink; whenever another creature you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on it if its power is less than Shelinda's, otherwise on Shelinda
Search for up to two basic lands (revealed two Swamps at 18:24), one onto battlefield tapped, one to hand, shuffle
actions.note: Table confirms Cultivate's battlefield land is NOT a land drop (18:45-18:53) - correct

actions.detail: Enters untapped (controls a Mountain)
3 mana from command zone, first cast (no commander tax)
Table states commander damage threshold is '20 damage through a commander' - INCORRECT, it is 21 combat damage from the same commander

2 mana. ETB: put +1/+1 counter on target creature (chose Shelinda). Shelinda trigger also puts a counter on Crawler (power less than Shelinda's). Static: creatures you control with +1/+1 counters have trample

Initially declared Shelinda -> Jared and Duskshell Crawler -> Weston; table catches that Duskshell Crawler entered this turn and cannot attack (summoning sickness). Revised: Shelinda (3/3) attacks Weston
Unblocked: Weston takes 3 (40->37); Alex gains 3 from lifelink (40->43)

actions.card: Hammer of Purphoros (heard as 'hammer of Peros')
actions.detail: Creatures you control have haste; {2},{T}, sac a land: create a 3/3 colorless Golem enchantment artifact creature token. Left with 2 mana, cannot activate this turn
Search library for a Forest card, put onto battlefield (untapped), shuffle
Revealed a Mountain-Forest dual from hand to have it enter untapped; table correctly explains land subtypes count (26:00-26:17)

actions.card: Wrecking Ball Arm (as heard; FF equipment)
actions.detail: Equipment: equipped creature has base P/T 7/7, can't be blocked by creatures with power 2 or less
Table correctly explains equipment cannot be voluntarily unattached; it stays until the creature leaves or it is attached to another creature
3 mana (Arcane Signet W + Orzhov Basilica 2). Flying 2/3; whenever one or more other creatures with power 2 or less enter under your control, draw a card (once each turn)

Clavileño attacks Jared (2 damage, Jared 40->38). Clavileño's trigger: attacking vampire that isn't a demon becomes a demon (gains 'when this dies, draw a card and create a tapped 4/3 white Vampire Demon token')
actions.note: 2 commander combat damage to Jared tracked on the life app

actions.detail: ETB: put +1/+1 counter on a creature. Beginning of combat: may move a +1/+1 counter from one target creature you control to a second (moved so Tidus gains one, gaining trample from Duskshell Crawler's static)
Table states max hand size 7 but you discard 'at end of turn or beginning of upkeep' - INCORRECT: discard to hand size happens during the active player's own cleanup step
Duskshell Crawler (1/3) and Shelinda (3/3) attack Bolt; Tidus does not attack (entered this turn)
4 damage to Bolt (40->36); Alex gains 3 from Shelinda lifelink (43->46)
actions.note: Alex at 46 life confirmed by table at 44:34

actions.detail: Tidus: whenever one or more creatures you control deal combat damage to a player, draw a card, then proliferate. Alex draws and proliferates (all creatures with counters get another)
Enters tapped
{2},{T}, sacrifice Myriad Landscape (just played): create 3/3 Golem token; Golem has haste from Hammer's static ability
Bolt notes he already played a land and cannot play another (one land per turn) - correct

actions.detail: 3 mana; flying, first strike 2/3; whenever she deals combat damage to a player, put a +1/+1 counter on each attacking creature
Drana has power 2 or less -> Weston draws a card
2 mana artifact; {1},{T}: add two mana (W/B)
Welcoming Vampire (2/3 flying) attacks Bolt. Extended teaching moment: attackers are declared all at once; you cannot add attackers after priority passes; instants respond via the stack
Clavileño converts attacking Welcoming Vampire to a Demon (death trigger rider). Bolt takes 2 (36->34)
Bolt missed his land drop (no land in hand)

actions.card: Unidentified 2-mana creature (heard as 'Lord just Lotto' / 'Waddle W'; likely an FF card, possibly Wakka)
actions.detail: Shelinda trigger puts +1/+1 counter on it (power less than Shelinda's) -> it has trample via Duskshell Crawler
'At the beginning of each end step, if you put a counter on a creature this turn, investigate' - unidentified permanent of Alex's

Table explains trample: excess over lethal damage to blockers carries to the player; blocker ordering chosen by attacking player when multi-blocked... (their explanation approximately correct; damage assignment order is chosen by the attacking player, defender chooses blocks)
Tidus: move a +1/+1 counter between creatures (Tidus up)
Tidus (5/5) attacks Weston; two creatures attack Bolt (5 total)

actions.card: Foretold white instant ('prevent all damage that would be dealt to you this turn')

Weston takes 5 (37->32); Bolt takes 0 (prevented)
Tidus trigger: draw a card, then proliferate (counters increment across Alex's board)
actions.validation_flag: CHECK: if ALL combat damage to Bolt was prevented and Weston still took damage, the 'deal combat damage to a player' condition is still met via Weston - trigger valid

actions.detail: Investigate -> create a Clue token ({2}, sacrifice: draw a card)
Cast as artifact (not a creature). Table correctly notes non-creature artifacts are not affected by summoning sickness for tap abilities
Taps the 3/3 Golem to Station: puts 3 charge counters on the Spacecraft (equal to tapped creature's power), reaching the Station 2+ tier
{1},{T}, sacrifice a land (Mountain Valley): draw two cards, may play an additional land this turn
